chapter_summary: Front matter only: title/copyright page, table of contents, preface (the book's argument for needing a verifiable edge and a guide to reading the book), and acknowledgments. No OHLCV-decidable statements anywhere in this file; every passage is either publisher boilerplate or discretionary/meta commentary about the book itself, so all five reviewed passages are recorded as rejects and there are no candidates.
